metadata.title: Pertuzumab/Trastuzumab (Phesgo®) and Docetaxel Therapy
metadata.indication: First-line treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive metastatic or locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer who have not received previous anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for metastatic disease.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
audit_limitations: Independent oncology and pharmacy validation pending.
Printed hepatic/count gaps or overlapping toxicity rows are explicitly referred for review; no invented numeric restart dose.
Postoperative or HER2-only continuation must use the chosen indication-specific regimen; early-breast cards do not silently select Phesgo maintenance 00785.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

action.recommendation: Relevant drug/excipient allergy is an NCCP exclusion. Identify the responsible agent and obtain specialist advice before any re-exposure.

rules.explanation: Relevant drug/excipient allergy is an NCCP exclusion. Identify the responsible agent and obtain specialist advice before any re-exposure.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy is excluded by this NCCP regimen; urgent specialist treatment review.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy is excluded by this NCCP regimen; urgent specialist treatment review.

action.recommendation: Breastfeeding is excluded; stop and review medicines and post-treatment restrictions.

rules.explanation: Breastfeeding is excluded; stop and review medicines and post-treatment restrictions.

action.recommendation: NCCP excludes clinically significant cardiac disease; oncology/cardiology must reassess the plan.

rules.explanation: NCCP excludes clinically significant cardiac disease; oncology/cardiology must reassess the plan.

action.recommendation: Rest dyspnoea from malignancy/comorbidity is an NCCP exclusion/risk. Urgent clinical assessment before Phesgo.

rules.explanation: Rest dyspnoea from malignancy/comorbidity is an NCCP exclusion/risk. Urgent clinical assessment before Phesgo.

action.recommendation: Confirmed symptomatic heart failure: discontinue Phesgo and refer urgently.

rules.explanation: Confirmed symptomatic heart failure: discontinue Phesgo and refer urgently.

action.recommendation: Obtain and review the required cardiac result before administration; do not infer a normal result.

rules.explanation: Obtain and review the required cardiac result before administration; do not infer a normal result.

action.recommendation: Insufficient Phesgo dosing data in severe renal impairment; individual specialist review, not an invented dose reduction.

rules.explanation: Insufficient Phesgo dosing data in severe renal impairment; individual specialist review, not an invented dose reduction.

action.recommendation: Validated HER2-positive disease is required.

rules.explanation: Validated HER2-positive disease is required.

action.recommendation: Check the complete indication, setting and prior-treatment restriction in NCCP before selecting this regimen.

rules.explanation: Check the complete indication, setting and prior-treatment restriction in NCCP before selecting this regimen.

action.recommendation: Outside NCCP ECOG 0–1 eligibility; consultant review.

rules.explanation: Outside NCCP ECOG 0–1 eligibility; consultant review.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 Phesgo hypersensitivity: stop permanently and manage urgently.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 Phesgo hypersensitivity: stop permanently and manage urgently.

action.recommendation: Withhold Phesgo for at least 3 weeks while urgently assessing suspected heart failure. Confirmed symptomatic heart failure requires discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Withhold Phesgo for at least 3 weeks while urgently assessing suspected heart failure. Confirmed symptomatic heart failure requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Immediately and permanently discontinue Phesgo for reaction-associated bronchospasm or ARDS; emergency management.

rules.explanation: Immediately and permanently discontinue Phesgo for reaction-associated bronchospasm or ARDS; emergency management.

action.recommendation: Assess dehydration, infection and severity promptly; consider fluids/electrolytes and early antidiarrhoeal treatment. Consider interrupting Phesgo if severe or prolonged diarrhoea does not improve; restart only when controlled after clinical review. Do not reduce the fixed Phesgo dose by a percentage.

rules.explanation: Assess dehydration, infection and severity promptly; consider fluids/electrolytes and early antidiarrhoeal treatment. Consider interrupting Phesgo if severe or prolonged diarrhoea does not improve; restart only when controlled after clinical review. Do not reduce the fixed Phesgo dose by a percentage.

action.recommendation: Before initiation, metastatic LVEF must be at least 50%; obtain specialist review if lower. A historical baseline value alone is not an on-treatment withholding criterion.

rules.explanation: Before initiation, metastatic LVEF must be at least 50%; obtain specialist review if lower. A historical baseline value alone is not an on-treatment withholding criterion.

action.recommendation: Withhold Phesgo for LVEF <40%, or 40–45% with decline at least 10 percentage points. NCCP specifies repeat LVEF within 3 weeks. The SmPC specifies withholding for at least 3 weeks and resumption only after recovery to >45%, or 40–45% with decline <10 points. No improvement/further decline requires consultant/cardiology review.

rules.explanation: Withhold Phesgo for LVEF <40%, or 40–45% with decline at least 10 percentage points. NCCP specifies repeat LVEF within 3 weeks. The SmPC specifies withholding for at least 3 weeks and resumption only after recovery to >45%, or 40–45% with decline <10 points. No improvement/further decline requires consultant/cardiology review.

action.recommendation: Obtain the baseline change to interpret this cardiac band; missing change is not a normal result.

rules.explanation: Obtain the baseline change to interpret this cardiac band; missing change is not a normal result.

action.recommendation: At least 6 weeks since the last dual HER2 dose: Phesgo 1200 mg/600 mg loading over 8 minutes, then observe 30 minutes; subsequent 600 mg/600 mg every 21 days. Confirm history and safety before prescribing.

rules.explanation: At least 6 weeks since the last dual HER2 dose: Phesgo 1200 mg/600 mg loading over 8 minutes, then observe 30 minutes; subsequent 600 mg/600 mg every 21 days. Confirm history and safety before prescribing.

action.recommendation: Less than 6 weeks since last dual HER2 dose, including IV-to-SC switch: 600 mg/600 mg maintenance over 5 minutes, observe 15 minutes. Confirm actual due date; this rule does not authorise an early dose.

rules.explanation: Less than 6 weeks since last dual HER2 dose, including IV-to-SC switch: 600 mg/600 mg maintenance over 5 minutes, observe 15 minutes. Confirm actual due date; this rule does not authorise an early dose.

action.recommendation: Baseline ANC <1.5 is an NCCP exclusion for starting chemotherapy.

rules.explanation: Baseline ANC <1.5 is an NCCP exclusion for starting chemotherapy.

action.recommendation: Clarify baseline versus ongoing assessment: initiation requires ANC ≥1.5; ongoing thresholds differ.

rules.explanation: Clarify baseline versus ongoing assessment: initiation requires ANC ≥1.5; ongoing thresholds differ.

action.recommendation: Severe hepatic dysfunction excludes this chemotherapy; review HER2 therapy separately.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic dysfunction excludes this chemotherapy; review HER2 therapy separately.

action.recommendation: Treat febrile neutropenia urgently and withhold chemotherapy pending recovery and review. Phesgo may sometimes continue during reversible myelosuppression with careful monitoring; assess complications.

rules.explanation: Treat febrile neutropenia urgently and withhold chemotherapy pending recovery and review. Phesgo may sometimes continue during reversible myelosuppression with careful monitoring; assess complications.

action.recommendation: NCCP: docetaxel not recommended if AST or ALT >10, ALP >6 or bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN.

rules.explanation: NCCP: docetaxel not recommended if AST or ALT >10, ALP >6 or bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN.

action.recommendation: SOURCE AMBIGUITY: intermediate hepatic rows combine AND/OR and bilirubin ≤1–1.5. Review all four liver results with pharmacy. The source describes considering 75% or 50% of ORIGINAL dose in different combinations; no automatic numeric dose or silent rounding is issued.

rules.explanation: SOURCE AMBIGUITY: intermediate hepatic rows combine AND/OR and bilirubin ≤1–1.5. Review all four liver results with pharmacy. The source describes considering 75% or 50% of ORIGINAL dose in different combinations; no automatic numeric dose or silent rounding is issued.

action.recommendation: Grade >2 neuropathy: decrease to 60 mg/m²; if it persists at 60, discontinue. Verify the actual dose and clinical recovery.

rules.explanation: Grade >2 neuropathy: decrease to 60 mg/m²; if it persists at 60, discontinue. Verify the actual dose and clinical recovery.

action.recommendation: Source reduction is 75 to 60 mg/m². No automatic additional lower dose is specified; review current dose. Verify the actual dose and clinical recovery.

rules.explanation: Source reduction is 75 to 60 mg/m². No automatic additional lower dose is specified; review current dose. Verify the actual dose and clinical recovery.

action.recommendation: Source reduction is 75 to 60 mg/m². No automatic additional lower dose is specified; review current dose. Verify the actual dose and clinical recovery.

rules.explanation: Source reduction is 75 to 60 mg/m². No automatic additional lower dose is specified; review current dose. Verify the actual dose and clinical recovery.

action.recommendation: Neuropathy persists at 60 mg/m²: discontinue docetaxel.

rules.explanation: Neuropathy persists at 60 mg/m²: discontinue docetaxel.

action.recommendation: This NCCP source has no numeric on-treatment count/reduction table. Assess count abnormality, recovery and local docetaxel policy; do not import TCHP thresholds.

rules.explanation: This NCCP source has no numeric on-treatment count/reduction table. Assess count abnormality, recovery and local docetaxel policy; do not import TCHP thresholds.

action.recommendation: Select a valid assessment stage: before starting or during treatment. An unrecognised value cannot select pretreatment versus ongoing criteria; independent safety findings still apply.

rules.explanation: Select a valid assessment stage: before starting or during treatment. An unrecognised value cannot select pretreatment versus ongoing criteria; independent safety findings still apply.

action.recommendation: The entered current LVEF is below the 50% pretreatment requirement. Obtain oncology/cardiology review before starting; on-treatment thresholds differ.

rules.explanation: The entered current LVEF is below the 50% pretreatment requirement. Obtain oncology/cardiology review before starting; on-treatment thresholds differ.

action.recommendation: Clarify whether this is the pretreatment result or an on-treatment measurement: initiation requires LVEF at least 50%; the ongoing hold threshold also uses the change from pretreatment. Independent urgent cardiac findings still apply.

rules.explanation: Clarify whether this is the pretreatment result or an on-treatment measurement: initiation requires LVEF at least 50%; the ongoing hold threshold also uses the change from pretreatment. Independent urgent cardiac findings still apply.

action.recommendation: Pause or slow the Phesgo injection, assess and treat the reaction, and observe until signs and symptoms resolve. Resumption requires the treating team's decision; this is not an automatic permanent stop.

rules.explanation: Pause or slow the Phesgo injection, assess and treat the reaction, and observe until signs and symptoms resolve. Resumption requires the treating team's decision; this is not an automatic permanent stop.

action.recommendation: Stop the injection and urgently manage the serious reaction. Specialist review is required before any re-exposure; consider permanent discontinuation according to severity and response. Grade 4, bronchospasm or ARDS require permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Stop the injection and urgently manage the serious reaction. Specialist review is required before any re-exposure; consider permanent discontinuation according to severity and response. Grade 4, bronchospasm or ARDS require permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Pause or slow the Phesgo injection and provide appropriate treatment. Monitor to complete resolution; severe injection reactions require specialist review and consideration of permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Pause or slow the Phesgo injection and provide appropriate treatment. Monitor to complete resolution; severe injection reactions require specialist review and consideration of permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Progression requires reassessment of the treatment strategy. Do not automatically continue this Phesgo plan.

rules.explanation: Progression requires reassessment of the treatment strategy. Do not automatically continue this Phesgo plan.

supportive_care.note: Phesgo minimal emetic risk. Cytotoxic antiemetics and taxane premedication apply only to their active phase.

treatment_phases.name: Phesgo combination
treatment_phases.label: Phesgo combination

administration.notes: One combined thigh injection; initial/reloading 1200/600 mg if indicated by actual history. Loading 8 min +30 min observation; maintenance 5 min +15 min observation. Complete observation before chemotherapy.
Docetaxel may escalate to 100 mg/m² if initial dose well tolerated.

treatment_phases.duration_text: Docetaxel minimum six cycles; may discontinue after 6–8 cycles or toxicity, with Phesgo continuation while beneficial and tolerated.

treatment_phases.name: HER2-only phase: verify setting and source regimen
treatment_phases.label: HER2-only phase: verify setting and source regimen
